Efs.description: Event-free survival cube, pooled CBTN PCX 30 V7 (2026-11-02 delivery) + Cumulus-BCH, all CBTN diagnoses, every diagnosis subtyped, durations in months. Pre-aggregated marginal cube (Presto GROUP BY CUBE, 128 grouping sets, 249,587 rows): each row counts patients over its non-null dimensions; null means the dimension is rolled up, never missing data. Missing data is a literal 'Not Reported' / 'Not Applicable' string, or -1 for durations. 7,440 patients, 3,364 events. Use event_free_survival_months with efs_status for survival curves. No small-cell suppression (173,192 rows have cnt = 1).
Efs.title: Patients

fields.name: cnt
fields.description: Patient count for the combination of dimension values in the row (SUM of patient counts; CBTN and Cumulus-BCH patients each count once). Within any grouping set the counts sum to the cohort (7,440); do not sum overlapping cube cells.
fields.title: Patient count

fields.name: event_free_survival_months
fields.description: Time from initial diagnosis to the first progression, recurrence, second malignancy or death; if none, to the most recent vital status, in whole months: floor(days / 30.4375), where 30.4375 = 365.25 / 12. 0 means under one month of follow-up, not missing. 120 means 120 months (10 years) or more. -1 means the duration is unknown (no initial diagnosis date, no vital-status record, or an end date before diagnosis); exclude it from survival curves. Read with efs_status. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: efs_status
fields.description: Whether the EFS clock stopped on an event. 'event' = first progression, recurrence, second malignancy or death observed; 'event-free' = none of these, censored at most recent vital status. 'Not Reported' = no patient-table row. Conventional EFS: death without a prior event counts as an event (unlike CBTN's workbook definition, which censors those deaths). Cumulus-BCH's EFS event rule is not confirmed to match. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: diagnosis
fields.description: Patient's diagnosis: CBTN demographics.diagnosis_type_cohort when it names a diagnosis ('Atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumor' shown as 'ATRT'); otherwise the CNS diagnosis category of the patient's Initial CNS Tumor event (else earliest event); 'Choroid plexus tumors' is folded into 'Choroid Plexus tumors'. Levels: ATRT, Choroid Plexus tumors, CNS Germ Cell Tumors, CNS Sarcoma, Craniopharyngioma, Ependymoma, Glioneuronal and neuronal tumors, High-Grade Glioma, Low-Grade Glioma, Medulloblastoma, Not Reported, Other, Other CNS Embryonal tumors. 'Other CNS Embryonal tumors' includes pineoblastoma and ETMR; see subtype. Filter to one value for a single-diagnosis view. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: protocol_name_and_arm
fields.description: protocol_name_and_arm of the patient's first medical-therapy regimen, ordered by regimen start (ties and undated regimens fall back to CBTN's row order), at any point after diagnosis, not limited to the initial treatment window. A protocol without an arm suffix (e.g. 'ACNS0331') means the arm was not recorded. 'Not Applicable' = no medical-therapy record; 'Not Reported' = regimen recorded, protocol not recorded; 'Other' = CBTN's label for a protocol outside its list. Because this is the first regimen at any time, a regimen started only after relapse can appear. For Cumulus-BCH patients with several protocols the first is a best guess. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: subtype
fields.description: Subtype at initial diagnosis, from cns_integrated_diagnosis taken within the patient's diagnosis. Medulloblastoma: 'MB-' prefix, OpenPedCan-refined where CBTN supplied it, SHH TP53-wildtype and TP53-mutant pooled as 'MB-SHH'. ATRT: 'ATRT-' prefix. Every other diagnosis: CBTN's integrated diagnosis exactly as delivered (no prefix). Four WHO types occur under both High-Grade and Low-Grade Glioma (Astroblastoma, MN1-altered; Astrocytoma, IDH-mutant; Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant, and 1p/19q-codeleted; Pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma), so they combine across the two when diagnosis is rolled up; filter or group by diagnosis too to keep them apart. 'NOS or NEC' / '-NOS/NEC' = no more specific type recorded; 'MB-non-WNT/non-SHH' = Group 3 or 4 not resolved further. 'Legacy SPNET' comes from Cumulus-BCH only (retired PNET term, no CBTN equivalent); 'NR-' subtypes are Cumulus-BCH patients with a subtype but no diagnosis. 'Not Reported' = subtype not recorded, CBTN's placeholder 'Specify', or diagnosis not reported. fields.name: site
fields.description: CBTN organization_name as delivered (the organization on the patient's event records); 'Cumulus-BCH' for every patient from the Cumulus-BCH cube. 'CBTN Non-Consortium Member' is a CBTN-supplied label for organizations outside the consortium. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.

fields.name: data_source

Determined by site, so every site sits under exactly one data_source. Null when the row aggregates over (rolls up) this dimension.
